data.title: Base-Ten Block Addition and Subtraction Adventure
data.description: Practice adding and subtracting numbers with regrouping and borrowing using visual base-ten blocks.

challenges.hint: Remember to group 10 ones into 1 ten when you have 10 or more ones!
Start by adding the ones, regroup if needed, then add the tens and hundreds.
If you don't have enough ones to subtract, trade 1 ten for 10 ones.
Check your columns carefully and borrow from the tens or hundreds place when necessary.
